New Build 4-Bed Detached | Accommodation Rd, Carlow Town | Walk to Schools & Train
Spacious 4-bed, 3-bath detached home with modern finishes, energy-efficient heating, off-street parking, and turnkey interiors. Qualifies for Help to Buy.

Spacious New Build 4-Bedroom Detached Home – Accommodation Road, Carlow Town

An exciting opportunity to acquire a large, brand new 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom detached home on Accommodation Road, Carlow Town. Ideally situated within walking distance of the town centre, local schools, train station, and a host of amenities, this property offers the perfect blend of modern efficiency, generous space, and a superb location.

This home is an excellent choice for first-time buyers (qualifies for the Help to Buy scheme) or those wishing to trade down to a comfortable, low-maintenance property in a convenient setting.

 Key Features:

- Prime location on Accommodation Road, just minutes’ walk to Carlow Town centre

- 4 spacious bedrooms, including one ground floor bedroom beside a guest bathroom — ideal for flexible living needs

- 3 bathrooms in total, including a modern ensuite

- Bright, airy interiors with excellent storage and natural light

Large fitted kitchen, bathroom tiling, high-quality laminate flooring throughout, and fully carpeted upstairs — move-in ready

- Air-to-water heating system ensuring excellent energy efficiency and low running costs

- Wide side entrance on one side, with secure gates on both gable ends for privacy and convenience

- Off-street parking, with further secure parking available on this quiet residential street

This is a turnkey property where the new owner can simply walk in and start living their dream. With a thoughtfully designed layout, modern finishes, and a highly convenient location, it offers exceptional comfort and practicality for everyday living.

Location Highlights:
- Walking distance to town centre shops, cafes, and services
- Easy stroll to local schools and train station
- Quiet, established street with a strong sense of community

Whether you’re a first-time buyer availing of the Help to Buy scheme, or seeking a modern, energy-efficient home in Carlow Town, this property ticks all the boxes.
